CustomField.description: What we estimate the opportunity to be worth when usage is fully ramped up. (“Est. Annual IdV Users” x $1 + (“Est. Annual Auth-only Users” x “Est. Auth-only User Active Months” x $0.025.)
CustomField.formula: MAX( IF( ISPICKVAL(LDGCRM_Opportunity_Type__c, "OM - New Agreement"), 30000, 0 ), ( LDGCRM_Est_Annual_Idv_Users__c + ( LDGCRM_Est_Annual_Auth_Only_Users__c * LDGCRM_Est_Auth_Only_Avg_Active_Months__c * 0.025 ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What we estimate the opportunity to be worth when usage is fully ramped up. (“Est. Annual IdV Users” x $1 + (“Est. Annual Auth-only Users” x “Est. Auth-only User Active Months” x $0.025.)
CustomField.label: Est. Annual Revenue (Fully Ramped)
